text:
Eva: Heads up — we had repeated heap_growth_high alerts for dev-gpu-0 and dev-gpu-1 overnight (~02:30-03:10). Seems noisy during our nightly batch. Where are the traces/logs for those hosts? Can we mute or adjust the threshold for dev cluster only?

Mike: I saw the same. Looks like exporter spikes during the batch job. Logs are in the logging cluster: https://logs.redwood.ai/goto/heap-dev-gpu-job :eyes:

Sophia: @Eva can you paste the alert query so I can propose a change?

Eva: Sure — here's the rule we have right now:
```
- alert: HeapGrowthHigh
  expr: sum by(host) (increase(process_resident_memory_bytes[5m])) > 500000000
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: P2
  annotations:
    runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/heap-growth
```

Sophia: Thanks. Two quick ideas: add a longer `for: 10m` to avoid transient spikes, and raise threshold to 1_000_000_000 for dev hosts. Also add an explicit `job != "nightly-prep"` exclusion or a label filter for `cluster="dev"` with a different severity. I'll open a PR with conservative changes.

Mike: I prefer avoiding a blanket mute. If it's just the nightly job, exclude that job label or scope the rule to prod only and lower severity for dev (P3). That keeps prod safety but quiets dev noise.

Ravi: @pagerduty-bot FYI — this is noisy alerts coming from dev cluster while we're iterating on the exporter.

Sophia: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerting/pull/198 — changes: dev threshold -> 1GB, `for: 10m`, add `job != "nightly-prep"` exclusion, add dashboard link in annotations. Please review.

Eva: Can we get a temporary silence on the dev heap alert until PR merges? I'd like 12h to stop paging our oncall while we iterate.

Mike: I can create a PagerDuty silence for the dev-alerts scope. Will post the ID here when done.

Mike: Silence created: PD-SILENCE-4567 (scope: alerts:heap_growth:cluster=dev), expires in 12h. :thumbsup:

Eva: Thanks — added traces link for one of the runs so folks can inspect GC patterns: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/xyz123. GC spikes align with the data prep job start.

Sophia: I'll also add an exclusion for `job=nightly-prep` in the rule so we don't accidentally hide prod issues. We'll keep the PR small and revert if it causes missed alerts.

Ravi: LGTM. Once PR merges, can someone remove the PD silence?

Mike: I'll remove silence early if PR merged and we verify metric behavior. Otherwise it expires automatically.

Eva: Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. Let's close the loop in this thread after the PR is merged and we watch one quiet nightly run. :raised_hands:
